gist.summary: Added Video to the video_audio app catalog and README. The static app has an Arabic right-to-left interface and implements Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login entirely in a single client-side index.html file, without a backend.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny headphones and points to a retro screen showing a right-to-left video app interface, beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized and shares the frame with the screen.
